context: Tests whether an agent distrusts green gates: reads the log for counts, finds the secret scan that scanned zero commits, the lint step that skips files, silent fallbacks, unpinned images, and asks for must-fail proof instead of trusting exit codes.

checklist.name: Zero-count gate found
checklist.description: The audit points at the secret-scan log line showing 0 commits scanned (shallow/partial clone) and treats that step as unproven despite being green. It fixes the clone depth or history and requires a count above zero.

checklist.name: Coverage compared mechanically
checklist.description: The audit compares the lint step's file list with the files the repository contains and finds the files it misses (hooks/helper scripts), fixing it with a glob or file-list derived from version control rather than a hand-kept list.

checklist.name: Silent fallbacks removed
checklist.description: The audit flags `|| true` / `2>/dev/null` / continue-on-error on a path that disables a check and makes the step fail hard on a tool error.

checklist.name: Must-fail proof added
checklist.description: The audit adds a self-test that runs in CI: a planted violation (secret assembled at runtime, tracked env file or lint error) that the gate must fail on, asserting on the finding in the report rather than only the exit code, plus the clean case passing.

checklist.name: Supply chain pinned with real values
checklist.description: Unpinned images are pinned by digest looked up from the registry; if no lookup is possible the audit says so and does not invent a hash.

checklist.name: Evidence as before/after numbers
checklist.description: The report states before/after in numbers (files covered, commits scanned, images pinned n/m) and cites CI log evidence per gate; gates without a must-fail proof are reported as unproven.
